findings.where: hsk-studio-harness-core/src/action/commands/document.rs:31-41 vs manual.rs:268-280 DRIVE_VIEWER rows and cli/drive.rs:146 + drive_viewer.rs:174 check_row
findings.what: drive routes the catalog ids to the viewer rows, whose check_row refuses undeclared keys, but the RUN_COMMANDS corpus (exported by corpus_json/manual) declares different keys: page.add declares `page` (row takes `after`), artboard.set_options declares `options` (row takes nine separate fields). A model following the corpus gets parameter_unknown. document.new: corpus `name` (and CLI --name) is the artboard name, but in the drive row `name` is the save-file base and the artboard name is `artboard_name`, so {"name":"mark"} silently names the file, not the artboard.
findings.fix: Make the corpus ParamSpecs equal the viewer rows: page.add AFTER instead of PAGE; set_artboard_options the nine fields instead of OPTIONS; document.new ARTBOARD_NAME (and keep the save name under a distinct key).
